best-time-to-trade-mcx.title: Best Time to Trade MCX in India
best-time-to-trade-mcx.hook: MCX gold barely moves in the morning — the real action doesn't start until 7 PM, when COMEX and NYMEX open for the day.
facts: MCX trades 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM IST, a 14.5-hour window
Best window for gold, silver and crude is 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM IST — when the US market is open
Base metals (copper, zinc, lead) peak earlier, 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST, around LME Ring close
MCX crude has two peak windows: 6:30–7:30 PM IST at US market open, and Wednesdays 8:00–8:30 PM IST for the EIA inventory report
Beginners should start in the calmer morning session (9 AM–1 PM IST) before trading the volatile evening session

comex-vs-mcx-gold.title: COMEX vs MCX Gold Price
comex-vs-mcx-gold.hook: MCX gold isn't priced by India at all — it's COMEX New York's dollar price run through a currency and duty formula.
facts: MCX gold price = (COMEX $/oz ÷ 31.1035 × 10 × USD/INR) plus import duties plus a market premium
Import duties add roughly 12–13%: 6% Basic Customs Duty + 3% AIDC + 3% GST
A domestic physical market premium of ₹200–600 per 10g is added on top of import parity
Every ₹1 move in USD/INR shifts MCX gold by roughly ₹1,000–1,300 per 10 grams
India's July 2024 Budget cut gold BCD from 15% to 6%, and MCX gold fell ₹5,000–6,000/10g on that single day

gold-etf-vs-mcx-gold.title: MCX Gold vs Gold ETF
gold-etf-vs-mcx-gold.hook: MCX gold futures profits are always taxed at your slab rate — up to 30% — while a Gold ETF held over 12 months pays just 12.5%.
facts: MCX gold offers roughly 14–20x leverage; Gold ETFs offer none — 1x price exposure only
MCX Gold Mini (100g) needs meaningful margin capital; Gold ETFs can be bought for ₹50–100 per unit, or via SIP from ₹500/month
MCX gold profits are taxed as business income at your slab rate with no LTCG benefit; Gold ETF held over 12 months gets 12.5% LTCG
MCX gold contracts expire monthly and must be rolled or squared off; Gold ETFs have no expiry
Sovereign Gold Bonds pay 2.5% p.a. interest and are tax-free at 8-year maturity, but have a 5-year lock-in before early redemption

how-much-money-to-start-mcx-trading.title: How Much Money to Start MCX Trading
how-much-money-to-start-mcx-trading.hook: You can open an MCX Crude Oil Mini position with as little as ₹3,000 in margin — but trading with just the margin amount is how beginners get wiped out on trade one.
facts: MCX Crude Oil Mini (10 barrels) needs ₹3,000–5,000 SPAN margin — the cheapest MCX entry point
MCX Gold Mini (100g) needs ₹55,000–75,000 SPAN margin
MCX Silver Micro (1 kg) needs ₹5,000–8,000 SPAN margin
Recommended practical starting capital is ₹8,000–15,000 for Crude Mini and ₹1,00,000–1,25,000 for Gold Mini — about 1.5–2x the margin
Always keep 1.5–2x the margin in your account to cover mark-to-market losses

mcx-circuit-limits.title: MCX Circuit Limits
mcx-circuit-limits.hook: If MCX gold moves 3% in a session, trading doesn't stop — it just pauses for 15 minutes before reopening at a wider band.
facts: MCX uses a two-stage circuit system: Stage 1 is ±3% from previous close, Stage 2 is ±6%
Hitting Stage 1 triggers a 15-minute trading halt, after which trading resumes at the expanded ±6% Stage 2 band
MCX crude oil and natural gas can expand circuit limits to ±9% in high-volatility periods with SEBI approval
During a circuit halt, no new orders can be placed and existing pending orders are frozen — but open positions remain active
Gold and silver rarely hit even the Stage 1 circuit under normal market conditions

mcx-commodity-tax-india.title: MCX Commodity Trading Tax in India
mcx-commodity-tax-india.hook: MCX trading profits get zero LTCG benefit — every rupee is taxed as business income at your slab rate, no matter how long you held the position.
facts: MCX commodity futures profits are taxed as non-speculative business income at your income slab rate — up to 30%
CTT (Commodity Transaction Tax) is 0.01% on the sell value of non-agricultural MCX futures, deducted automatically by your broker
Commodity traders must file ITR-3, not ITR-1, ITR-2 or ITR-4
Turnover for tax audit = the absolute sum of all profits and losses; a tax audit is mandatory above ₹10 crore turnover, or below that if profit/loss is under 6% of turnover
Non-speculative business losses can be carried forward for 8 years but cannot be set off against salary income

mcx-contract-expiry.title: MCX Contract Expiry Dates
mcx-contract-expiry.hook: Forget your MCX gold position past expiry and your broker won't just close it — it can go into a physical gold delivery process you never signed up for.
facts: MCX Gold and Silver contracts expire on the 5th of the delivery month (or the prior trading day if the 5th is a holiday)
MCX Crude Oil expires on the 19th of the contract month, cash-settled against NYMEX WTI converted at the RBI reference rate
Copper, Zinc, Aluminium and Lead expire on the last day of the contract month
DVCAL is the volume-weighted average price MCX uses to cash-settle contracts on expiry day
Retail traders should square off or roll over 3–4 trading days before expiry, since liquidity drops sharply in the final days

mcx-gold-contracts.title: MCX Gold Contracts: Standard, Mini, Guinea, Petal
mcx-gold-contracts.hook: MCX doesn't just have one gold contract — it has four, from a 1-gram Petal to a full 1-kilogram Standard, and picking the wrong one can 10x your capital requirement.
facts: MCX Gold Mini lot size is 100 grams, one-tenth the size of the Standard 1 kg contract
MCX Gold Guinea is an 8-gram contract aimed at small participants and jewellers hedging small orders
MCX Gold Petal is a 1-gram contract, the smallest MCX gold contract available
Gold Standard and Gold Mini expire on the 5th of the contract month; Gold Guinea and Gold Petal expire on the last working day of the month
Physical delivery is compulsory if a position is held to expiry without squaring off, settled in 995 purity gold bars at MCX-accredited vaults in Ahmedabad, Mumbai and Delhi

mcx-gold-vs-physical-gold.title: MCX Gold vs Physical Gold
mcx-gold-vs-physical-gold.hook: When you buy MCX gold, you don't own a single gram of gold — you own a contract, and 99.9% of retail traders never take delivery.
facts: MCX gold is a futures contract, not physical gold — the vast majority of retail traders settle in cash, never receiving metal
Taking physical delivery requires holding through the delivery period, paying the full contract value (not just margin), and receiving Electronic Gold Receipts via an NSDL vault account
MCX Gold Mini's minimum entry is about ₹55,000–75,000 in margin; physical/digital gold can be bought from as little as ₹500
MCX gold offers roughly 16x leverage on Gold Mini; physical gold has no leverage
MCX gold profits are taxed as business income at your slab rate; jewellery/coins get LTCG at 12.5% after 24 months

mcx-lot-sizes.title: MCX Lot Sizes
mcx-lot-sizes.hook: MCX Gold Mini is 100 grams and MCX Crude Mini is just 10 barrels — the 'Mini' contracts exist specifically so retail traders don't need lakhs of rupees just to place one trade.
facts: MCX Gold Mini lot size is 100 grams, one-tenth of the 1 kg Standard contract, quoted in ₹ per 10 grams
MCX Crude Oil Mini lot size is 10 barrels versus the 100-barrel Standard lot
MCX Silver contracts come in three sizes: Standard (30 kg), Mini (5 kg) and Micro (1 kg)
Tick size for MCX Gold is ₹1 per 10g, worth ₹100 per tick on Standard and ₹10 per tick on Mini
Margin is typically 4–7% of contract value across MCX commodities

mcx-margin-calculation.title: MCX Margin Calculation
mcx-margin-calculation.hook: Your MCX margin isn't one number — it's SPAN margin set by the exchange plus an extra exposure margin your broker bolts on top, and the two together usually run 6–9% of contract value.
facts: Total initial MCX margin = SPAN margin (typically 4–6% of contract value) + broker exposure margin (typically 1–3%)
SPAN margin is updated twice daily by MCX using a risk model simulating extreme price scenarios over a one-day horizon
A margin call triggers when your account balance falls below the maintenance margin, typically 75% of the initial margin
MTM (mark-to-market) settlement happens every trading day — profits are credited and losses debited to your account overnight, they can't be deferred
If a margin call isn't met, the broker will square off the position at the prevailing market price

mcx-margin-calculator.title: MCX Margin Calculator
mcx-margin-calculator.hook: SPAN margin is exactly the same at every SEBI-registered broker — it's the extra exposure margin on top that actually varies and changes what you pay to trade.
facts: SPAN margin (also called initial margin) is the minimum deposit the exchange requires to open an MCX position, calculated daily based on volatility
Brokers typically add 2–5% exposure margin on top of SPAN as an additional buffer
MCX Gold Mini (100g) SPAN margin runs approximately 4–5% of contract value
MCX Crude Oil Mini (10 barrels) SPAN margin is roughly ₹3,000–5,000
MTM (mark-to-market) losses are debited from the account every evening, not just at contract expiry

mcx-order-types.title: MCX Order Types Explained
mcx-order-types.hook: Most beginners set their stop-loss as a plain 'SL' order — the one order type that can fail to fill exactly when you need it most, if price gaps past your limit.
facts: MCX supports four main order types: Market, Limit, SL (Stop Loss Limit) and SL-M (Stop Loss Market)
SL-M requires only a trigger price and always executes as a market order once triggered — recommended for stop losses
SL requires both a trigger price and a limit price; if the market gaps past the limit, the order may never fill
If you're long, your stop loss must be a SELL order; if you're short, it must be a BUY order — placing it on the wrong side is a common beginner mistake
Cover Orders and Bracket Orders typically don't work in the last 20–30 minutes before MCX close

mcx-rollover.title: MCX Futures Rollover
mcx-rollover.hook: Rolling over an MCX contract isn't free — it costs you the price gap between the two months, and if you wait until the final days, that spread can blow out on thin liquidity.
facts: Rollover means selling your expiring near-month contract and buying the next month simultaneously, to keep exposure without taking delivery
The optimal rollover window is 5–7 trading days before expiry — for Crude, roll by the 16th–17th; for Gold, roll by the 2nd–3rd
Rollover cost = (next month price − near month price) × lot size, known as the contango cost
Failing to roll or square off before expiry triggers physical delivery settlement, requiring special KYC and full contract value payment
Transaction costs during rollover — brokerage, CTT, exchange charges — are deductible as business expenses in ITR-3

mcx-trading-hours.title: MCX Trading Hours in India
mcx-trading-hours.hook: MCX doesn't close at 3:30 PM like the stock market — it stays open until 11:30 PM IST, and most of the real price action happens after most traders have already logged off.
facts: MCX trading hours are 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM IST, Monday to Friday, with no lunch break
The peak window is 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM IST, when COMEX gold, COMEX silver and NYMEX crude are all active simultaneously
The EIA Crude Oil Inventory report releases every Wednesday around 8:00–8:30 PM IST and causes sharp moves
The dead zone is roughly 12:00 PM to 4:30 PM IST, when European markets are quiet and US markets haven't opened
MCX is closed on Saturdays, Sundays, and roughly 14–16 declared holidays per year, but holds a special Diwali Muhurat trading session

what-is-comex.title: What is COMEX?
what-is-comex.hook: MCX gold doesn't have a price of its own — every number you see is COMEX New York's dollar price, converted to rupees with Indian duties bolted on.
facts: COMEX (Commodity Exchange, Inc.), based in New York, is a division of CME Group and sets the global reference price for gold, silver, copper and palladium
MCX gold = COMEX price ÷ 31.1035 × 10 × USD/INR × (1 + duties) — a mathematically derived price, not an independent one
The COMEX electronic (Globex) session runs nearly 24 hours; the highest-volume window for Indian traders is 7:00 PM–11:30 PM IST
Crude oil and natural gas actually trade on NYMEX, a sister exchange under the same CME Group, not COMEX itself
Copper, zinc, aluminium, lead and nickel on MCX derive their pricing from the London Metal Exchange (LME), not COMEX

which-mcx-commodity-to-trade.title: Which MCX Commodity Should I Trade?
which-mcx-commodity-to-trade.hook: With under ₹50,000, most beginners jump straight to gold — but MCX Crude Oil Mini needs as little as ₹3,000–5,000 in margin and is the more accessible starting point.
facts: Under ₹25,000 capital: MCX Crude Oil Mini is recommended for its low margin and manageable ₹710 P&L per 1% move
₹75,000–1,50,000 capital: MCX Gold Mini is recommended as the most liquid MCX contract, tracking COMEX cleanly
MCX Silver Micro (1 kg) costs about ₹2,470 per 1% move and is not recommended for beginners due to 3–5% daily volatility
MCX Natural Gas can see 5–10% daily moves and 15–20% moves several times a year — strongly avoid as a beginner
Best trading windows: Crude Mini 7:30–9:30 PM IST, Gold Mini 7:30–11:30 PM IST, Copper/Zinc 2:00–6:00 PM IST

why-usdinr-affects-mcx-gold.title: Why USD/INR Affects MCX Gold Price
why-usdinr-affects-mcx-gold.hook: MCX gold can rise even on a day when international gold is completely flat — all it takes is the rupee weakening against the dollar.
facts: A 1% rupee depreciation adds roughly ₹1,000–1,500 per 10 grams to MCX gold, even if COMEX gold is unchanged
MCX gold price = (COMEX $/oz ÷ 31.1035) × 10 × USD/INR × (1 + duty factor), where the duty factor is approximately 1.154
India imports over 700–800 tonnes of gold per year, making the import parity price the anchor for MCX pricing
On a Gold Mini lot (100g), a 1% rupee move creates roughly ₹10,000–15,000 in P&L impact purely from currency
Crude oil, silver and MCX base metals are all similarly exposed to USD/INR since they are dollar-priced and largely imported
